test_healthcheck: test the healthcheck endpoint by polling /healthcheck and verifying the response status code is 200 and body contains 'ok'
poll_endpoint: poll an API endpoint with retries until the expected HTTP status code is returned or timeout is reached
poll_with_error_field: poll an endpoint and retry when the response JSON contains a field with 'retry later' message
get_request: send an HTTP GET request to a relative URL on the specified server base URL
post_request: send an HTTP POST request with JSON body to a relative URL on the specified server base URL
